_comment: Sliver Hive's '{5}, {T}: create a 1/1 colorless Sliver. Activate only if you control a Sliver' as a viewer LINE (`taptoken=`), on a board where it is NOT lethal -- so this pins the human-play affordance itself rather than the combat math the sibling slivers_hive_token_lethal.json asserts. Five spare sources plus the activating Hive: Cavern of Souls' unrestricted '{T}: Add {C}' mode is what pays the {5} (its coloured mana is colored_creature_only, and Ancient Ziggurat is creature_mana_only and could not pay this at all). Muscle Sliver satisfies the 'you control a Sliver' gate. The ability reports UNVERIFIED in short audit sweeps because {5} is rarely spare with the Hive untapped in 6 games x 8 turns; that is a sweep coverage limit, not a reachability gap, and this fixture is the standing proof.
